reuse_scope: VAL808 is a non-holdout CONTINUITY DEVELOPMENT benchmark. It may be used as secondary/continuity DEVELOPMENT_ABLATION_EVIDENCE, but is NOT the primary Phase28 ablation population and NOT a substitute for ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT. Any VAL808 ablation evidence must be labelled DEVELOPMENT_ABLATION_EVIDENCE and may NOT be presented as out-of-sample routing validation.
